topic.title: Average Height Without Built-ins
topic.description: Calculates average height manually using a loop accumulator without sum() or len(). Deepens understanding of how built-in functions work internally.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Implementing accumulator pattern with a loop to build sum and count from scratch.
learningNotes.challenges: Remembering to initialize both sum and count before the loop.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Compare performance and readability with built-in approach.
